h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhind

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhind

items.pText: Bhind is a district town in the Chambal region of northern Madhya Pradesh, close to the Uttar Pradesh border. The land around it is cut by ravines, and summers are among the harshest in central India. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Bhind's schools, residential colonies and public gardens. It is made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,000 km away, and installed by our team or a dealer.

Many enquiries from a town like Bhind come from schools putting in their first playground. For a first project, fewer pieces of good quality usually serve better than a crowded set. A slide, a pair of swings and a see-saw cover the main kinds of play. Each of these is made from galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic and carries our standard warranty. Extra pieces can be added once you see how children use the ground.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A first playground for a Bhind school

c: Choose the corner of the ground that gets shade after midday, since May and June afternoons are too hot for play in direct sun. If no shade exists, plant trees on the west side when you install the equipment.
Hard, dry soil is common here. Grout the posts into concrete, and lay rubber flooring under swings and the slide exit, where children land. Lighter colours stay cooler. A

items.q: What should a school's first playground include?
items.a: A slide, a pair of swings and a see-saw cover sliding, swinging and balancing. We plan them on a layout drawing with space left for climbers or a merry-go-round later.

items.q: How do we keep a playground usable in extreme summer heat?
items.a: Place it where there is afternoon shade, plant trees on the west side, choose lighter colours and schedule play for mornings and evenings in May and June.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Bhind?
items.a: Yes. We make it in Vasai, send it by road and install it with our team or a dealer serving Madhya Pradesh.
